== Notes ==
{{bug|When having less than 50% health, the block chance applies immediately while the health regeneration is delayed. Using any [[skill]] or swapping from a [[vampiric]] weapon to a non-vampiric one will provide you the proper health regeneration immediately.}}
* Heroes usually will wait until their health is below 30%, rather than below 50%, to start casting this, and they do not reserve energy to cast it. This typically means that heroes will die without ever managing to successfully cast it.
